Reconcile provisional and definitive trees of one plot

Source: R/inventaire_video.R
rapprocher_arbres.Rd

Matches the provisional trees (phone, layer arbres) with the definitive detections of the Groma server, for **one** plot, by an optimal assignment (Hungarian method) on the horizontal position. Pairs farther than tolerance_m are forbidden; the cost is the distance plus poids_dbh_m_par_cm per cm of diameter difference, which breaks ties between close candidates (a greedy match would lose trees).

Usage

rapprocher_arbres(
  provisoires,
  definitifs,
  centre,
  convergence_deg = 0,
  tolerance_m = 0.5,
  rayon_m = 20,
  seuil_diam_cm = 7.5,
  unite_azimut = c("deg", "gr"),
  tolerance_deg = 1,
  poids_dbh_m_par_cm = 0.01,
  ecart_dbh_alerte_cm = 10,
  ecart_dbh_alerte_rel = 0.5,
  generer_uuid = .uuid_v4
)

Arguments

provisoires

sf POINT, or data.frame with x, y (Lambert-93): rows of the arbres layer of the plot (uuid, dbh_cm, tree_id and field attributes).

definitifs

sf POINT, or data.frame with x, y: definitive detections (dbh_cm, optional h_m, h_source, houppier_id, methode).

centre

Numeric c(x, y): measured plot centre (Lambert-93). Or the centres_mesures rows of the plot (sf POINT, or data.frame with x, y): Groma adds a row at each measurement and never rewrites one, so the most recent (largest fid, else last row) is used.

convergence_deg

Meridian convergence at the plot (degrees).

tolerance_m

Maximal matching distance (m). Default 0.5.

rayon_m, seuil_diam_cm, unite_azimut, tolerance_deg

Numbering parameters, see numeroter_arbres.

poids_dbh_m_par_cm

Cost of 1 cm of diameter gap, in metres. Default 0.01.

ecart_dbh_alerte_cm, ecart_dbh_alerte_rel

Diameter gap alert thresholds. Defaults 10 cm and 0.5.

generer_uuid

Function returning a new uuid (for the new trees).

Value

A list with arbres (same class as provisoires), apparies (data.frame uuid, definitif = row of definitifs, distance_m), nouveaux and non_retrouves (uuids), numeros_modifies (data.frame uuid, ancien, nouveau) and alertes (data.frame uuid, motif, dbh_provisoire, dbh_definitif).

Details

  • Matched: field attributes kept (essence_arbre, espece, statut, qualite, notes, photos, measured h_m); position, dbh_cm, methode and CHM height updated; definitif if essence_arbre is filled in, else a_completer. A faux_positif stays so (alert faux_positif_retrouve). Alert ecart_dbh when the diameter gap exceeds ecart_dbh_alerte_cm and ecart_dbh_alerte_rel of the smaller diameter.

  • New (definitive without provisional): new uuid, statut = "vivant", a_completer.

  • Provisional not found: a_verifier, attributes and position kept.

  • Numbering recomputed with numeroter_arbres on the trees that are neither a_verifier nor faux_positif; the former number goes to num_provisoire. a_verifier trees get V1, V2..., faux_positif trees F1, F2... (by azimuth), so tree_id stays unique and non-empty.

  • A tree that leaves the inventory once measured (outside the radius or under the threshold) is kept as a_verifier when it carries field attributes or was provisional, and dropped otherwise.

No field attribute is ever lost.

Lifecycle

Experimental (spec 061).

Examples

prov <- data.frame(uuid = c("u1", "u2"), plot_id = "P1", tree_id = c("1", "2"),
                   dbh_cm = c(30, 25), essence_arbre = c("hetre", NA),
                   etat_detection = "provisoire",
                   x = c(1000, 1003), y = c(2005, 2004))
def <- data.frame(x = c(1000.2, 1003.1), y = c(2005, 2004), dbh_cm = c(31, 24),
                  methode = "classique")
rapprocher_arbres(prov, def, centre = c(1000, 2000))$arbres
#>   uuid plot_id tree_id dbh_cm essence_arbre etat_detection      x    y
#> 1   u1      P1       1     31         hetre      definitif 1000.2 2005
#> 2   u2      P1       2     24          <NA>    a_completer 1003.1 2004
#>   num_provisoire   methode h_m h_source houppier_id statut distance_m  azimut
#> 1              1 classique  NA     <NA>          NA   <NA>      5.004  2.2906
#> 2              2 classique  NA     <NA>          NA   <NA>      5.061 37.7757
